subject: Spec: Session restore toast notification
body:
## Problem
restoreAutosave() silently rebuilds the exam from sessionStorage when a user returns mid-session. Kai doesn't know his progress was restored. He may think the exam reset. This creates confusion, not confidence.

## Behavior

### State Machine: Session Restore

States:
- NO_SAVE: No sessionStorage data. Exam starts fresh. No toast.
- RESTORE_PENDING: sessionStorage data found. restoreAutosave() is about to run.
- RESTORED: Exam rebuilt from saved state. Toast shown briefly.
- TOAST_DISMISSED: Toast hidden. User continues exam.

Transitions:
- NO_SAVE: No transition. Start fresh.
- RESTORE_PENDING -> RESTORED: restoreAutosave() completes. Toast shown.
- RESTORED -> TOAST_DISMISSED: After 3000ms (auto-dismiss). OR: User clicks X on toast.

## Visual Spec

### Toast: RESTORED state

Position: Fixed, top-right, 16px from top/right edge.
Color: `var(--bg-surface)` background, `var(--border-default)` border, 1px.
Text: '🔄 Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.'
Icon button: X (close) -- aria-label='Dismiss progress restored notice'
Duration: 3000ms auto-dismiss. Fade out over 200ms.
Animation: Slide in from right (transform translateX). 200ms. prefers-reduced-motion: instant appear.

### Toast Anatomy
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  🔄 Progress restored. Pick up where   X│
│     you left off.                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Copy
'🔄 Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.'

(11 words -- under 12 word limit. Direct. Not celebratory -- restoration is neutral, not an achievement.)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Toast only shows when restoreAutosave() finds saved data (not on fresh start)
2. Toast position: fixed, top-right, z-index above all content
3. Copy: '🔄 Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.'
4. Auto-dismiss after 3000ms
5. Manual dismiss (X button) works
6. Slide-in animation with prefers-reduced-motion guard
7. Toast does NOT block any exam content
8. aria-live='polite' on toast region (screen reader friendly)

## What NOT to change
- restoreAutosave() logic
- sessionStorage behavior
- 800ms debounce on autosave

## Scope
- exam.html: restoreAutosave() function (add toast trigger)
- exam.html: toast HTML template
- shared/styles.css: .session-restore-toast styles + slide-in animation

## Related
- sw-10: Session restore UX (this spec)
- .design-system.md Section 19 (animation: 200ms state transitions)
